summary.text: Verona Mauga is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 31 who took office on January 1, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: Verona Mauga was born in Hawaii, and her career experience includes working as an entrepreneur, according to Ballotpedia.
She succeeded Brett Garner as the representative for District 31.
